name: M5 x 10 mm OD x 140 mm aluminium round female-female threaded standoff (spacer)
vendor: eBay seller listing 'M5 aluminium round threaded sleeve standoff' (same listing as the old 8 x 100 post)
author: catalogue (modelled in assemblies/froggy_v9.py:_drum_post from the listing dimensions; the vendor gives no STEP, so the part is a built cylinder)
price_note: not read (eBay refused every fetch, HTTP 403); assumed from the 8 x 100 (about 3 USD) plus length

dims_mm.source: web search listing text for 305764997563: 8 mm OD lengths 10 to 150 without 140, 140 offered as 'M5*140mm - D10'; thread depth assumed 12 (long sizes are threaded from each end)

why_10_od: no 8 OD x 140 listing was found (Lyntron 8 OD stops at 32, RJX Hobby 8 OD lists 120 and 150, eBay 8 OD lists up to 150 without 140); the brief forbids stacking, and Sawyer asked for a 140 tube, so the listed 10 OD x 140 is used. At r 66 the 10 OD body spans r 61..71, 2 clear of the tube bore r 73.
material: aluminium (alloy not stated on the listing)
why_140: a stock length: the tube foot stands on ring B (Z 54.175) and the post runs ring B top to the top disc underside, 140 = TUBE_H (I017)
